```python
import chrono as ch
import chrono.irrlicht as irr

# Initialize PyChrono environment and core components
ch.util.SetChVerbosityLevel(ch.VerbosityLevel.VERBOSE)
ch.pyrender.RenderMode_RAYTRACING_TPLASMA = 1

# Create the Chrono system with gravity
system = ch.ChSystem()

# Set gravity
system.SetGravitationalAcceleration(ch.ChVector3d(0, -9.81, 0))

# Create a ground body
ground = ch.ChBodyEasyTerrain(
    100, 1, 100,  # x, y, z dimensions
    20,  # number of subdivisions
    ch.ChVector3d(0, -1, 0)  # position
)
ground.SetPos(ch.ChVector3d(0, -1, 0))
ground.SetNoMass()
system.AddBody(ground)

# Load the Turtlebot model
turtlebot = ch.ChBodyEasyMesh(
    'models/turtlebot.obj',  # path to mesh file
    1,  # mass
    ch.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0),  # inertia
    ch.ChFrame3d(ch.ChVector3d(0, 0.5, 0), ch.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0))  # position and orientation
)
system.AddBody(turtlebot)

# Create joints and motors for the Turtlebot's wheels
left_wheel = ch.ChLinkLockSpherical()
right_wheel = ch.ChLinkLockSpherical()

left_wheel.Initialize(
    turtlebot,
    ch.ChFrame3d(ch.ChVector3d(-0.2, -0.2, 0), ch.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)),
    ground,
    ch.ChFrame3d(ch.ChVector3d(-0.2, -0.7, 0), ch.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0))
)
right_wheel.Initialize(
    turtlebot,
    ch.ChFrame3d(ch.ChVector3d(0.2, -0.2, 0), ch.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)),
    ground,
    ch.ChFrame3d(ch.ChVector3d(0.2, -0.7, 0), ch.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0))
)

system.AddLink(left_wheel)
system.AddLink(right_wheel)

left_motor = ch.ChLinkMotorRotationAngle()
right_motor = ch.ChLinkMotorRotationAngle()

left_motor.Initialize(
    left_wheel,
    ch.ChFrame3d(ch.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), ch.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)),
    ground,
    ch.ChFrame3d(ch.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), ch.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0))
)
right_motor.Initialize(
    right_wheel,
    ch.ChFrame3d(ch.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), ch.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)),
    ground,
    ch.ChFrame3d(ch.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), ch.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0))
)

system.AddLink(left_motor)
system.AddLink(right_motor)

# Create Irrlicht application
app = irr.ChIrrApp(system, 'Turtlebot Simulation', irr.dimension2D(800, 600))

# Set camera and lighting
app.SetCameraPosition(ch.ChVector3d(0, 5, 10))
app.SetCameraTarget(ch.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0))
app.EnableSunLight()

# Simulation loop
while app.Run():
    # Control left and right turns at specified times
    if app.GetChTime() < 5:
        left_motor.SetMotorFunction(ch.ChFunction_Const(0))
        right_motor.SetMotorFunction(ch.ChFunction_Const(0))
    elif app.GetChTime() < 10:
        left_motor.SetMotorFunction(ch.ChFunction_Ramp(0, 1))
        right_motor.SetMotorFunction(ch.ChFunction_Const(0))
    else:
        left_motor.SetMotorFunction(ch.ChFunction_Const(0))
        right_motor.SetMotorFunction(ch.ChFunction_Ramp(0, -1))

    # Update and render
    system.Update()
    app.Render()
```
